## Checklist

- [ ] Existing Chrome components and layer boundaries are respected.
- [ ] New user-facing English strings have zh-Hans translations.
- [ ] Current guides describe the resulting behavior and removed entry points.
- [ ] Upstream license and attribution notices are preserved.
- [ ] No credentials, private paths or conversation data are included.
- [ ] Contributor credit uses a public name/GitHub handle, not a private email.

This retained template does not authorize pushing or creating a PR. Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for owner authorization. Do not include signing credentials or notarization secrets.
